slider.custom_body: To create a custom slider (read only), select an {entity} above, then define the {min} and {max} values below.
slider.custom_example: For example, this allows you to display your solar production within a specific range.
slider.relative_slide: Relative slide (incompatible with tap to slide)
slider.live_update_body1: By default, sliders are updated only on release. When this option is enabled, the slider will update the entity state while sliding.
slider.live_update_body2: This feature is not recommended for all entities, disable it if you encounter issues.
slider.vertical_body: When using vertical fill orientation (top or bottom), swiping over the card on mobile will activate the slider. This is because there's no way to distinguish between scrolling and slider interaction.
slider.value_locked_body: Value position is forced to "Right" because "Show button info" is enabled. Disable it to change this setting.
slider.invert: Invert slider direction (100% fill equals minimum)
slider.allow_off: Allow slider to turn off light (reach 0%)
slider.transition_body1: This feature only works for lights that support the {attr}.
slider.transition_body2: Enabling this for lights that do not support transitions will unfortunately have no effect. Defaults to 500ms unless overridden below.

sub_button.behavior_body: By default, you need to tap the sub-button to reveal the slider. To make the slider always visible, enable the "Always show slider" option in the Layout section below.
sub_button.actions_disabled_body: Tap, double tap, and hold actions are disabled on this sub-button because "Always show slider" is enabled.
sub_button.visibility_body: The sub-button will be shown when ALL conditions are fulfilled. If no conditions are set, the sub-button will always be shown.
sub_button.hide_unavailable: Hide when parent entity is unavailable
sub_button.alignment_locked_title: Buttons alignment locked by sub-button settings
sub_button.alignment_locked_body: One or more sub-buttons explicitly enable "Fill available width". To change alignment, first disable "Fill available width" in those sub-buttons.
sub_button.groups_mode_body: You are now in {mode_bold}. All sub-buttons must be inside a group to ensure consistent ordering. You can rename, reorder, or delete groups as needed.
sub_button.info_body: This editor allows you to add customized sub-buttons to your card. Sub-buttons support three types:
sub_button.desc_slider: Control or display numeric values (brightness, volume, temperature, etc.)
sub_button.info_usage: Use {slider} sub-buttons to control light brightness, media player volume, or climate temperature. Use {dropdown} sub-buttons to select media sources, HVAC modes, or light effects. Use {default} buttons for simple on/off controls or custom actions.
sub_button.info_organize: You can organise sub-buttons individually or group them together. Groups can be arranged inline (side by side) or in rows (stacked vertically), and buttons within groups can be displayed inline or in a column layout.
sub_button.rows_detected_body: The card height (rows) is explicitly set in your configuration. This will prevent automatic row adjustments when sub-buttons are added (for example, when adding bottom sub-buttons). Click the button below to remove the override and let Bubble Card auto-calculate the rows.
sub_button.bottom_layout_body: Adding bottom sub-buttons will automatically switch this card to the "Large" layout (this is the new recommended layout). This notice will disappear once you add bottom sub-buttons.

show.background: Show background when entity is on
show.light_background: Background colour based on light colour
show.accent_color: Use accent colour instead of light colour

actions.hold_disabled_body: Hold action is disabled on slider buttons to prevent conflicts with the slider drag gesture.

layout.rows_set_title: Rows are already set in the "Layout" options
layout.rows_set_body: If you want to change the rows, you can do it in the "Layout" options at the top of this editor. Or remove it from your config in YAML to enable this option.
layout.deprecated_bold: The card layout options are deprecated, but still available for backwards compatibility.
layout.deprecated_body: Please use the new sub-button groups and layout options instead for better flexibility.
layout.large_grid: Large with sub-buttons in a grid (Layout: min. 2 rows)

nested.title: Nested pop-ups are not supported
nested.body: Adding a standalone pop-up inside another standalone pop-up is not supported. Please create this pop-up outside of the current pop-up instead.

migration.unique_hash_error: Choose a unique hash before migrating this pop-up.
migration.unable_error: Unable to migrate this pop-up from the current dashboard editor.
migration.notice_title: Your pop-ups need to be migrated
migration.notice_body: This pop-up still uses the old vertical-stack wrapper. Migrate it to the standalone format for much better performance and to manage its content with the same drag-and-drop flow as a section view.
migration.horizontal_body: Horizontal stacks were detected. Their cards will be converted so you can drag and drop them individually while keeping the same layout (this option can be disabled if needed).
migration.convert_stacks: Convert horizontal stacks to grid cards
migration.rollback_body: Even though it has been tested to handle all known legacy cases, I still recommend keeping a backup if you may want to roll back to v3.1.6 later.
migration.notice_intro: Since Bubble Card v3.2.0, {bold} It's easy and only takes a few clicks!
migration.notice_intro_bold: your pop-ups must be migrated to the new standalone format.
migration.notice_announcement: If you missed it, check out the {link} (it took me about 10 hours to write it!) to see all the new features and changes.
migration.notice_change_body: Standalone pop-ups render much faster, work more reliably, and no longer need to live inside a {stack} card (finally!). You also get access to a new editor based on the Home Assistant section editor, with the exact same drag-and-drop approach for easier and faster editing!
migration.notice_video_summary: Watch how the new editor works
migration.notice_features: Pop-ups now have new features as well, with new modes (like a centred one), a new optional classic style and a performance mode for smoother animations on lower-end devices.
migration.notice_how_title: How to migrate from the editor?
migration.notice_how_body: Open the editor for each pop-up showing {available}, then just click {migrate}.
migration.notice_yaml_body: Replace the legacy pop-up config with the standalone format:
migration.notice_protip_body: Honestly, if you're still using YAML for Bubble Card at this point, you might want to give the new editor a try, it makes creating and editing pop-ups a breeze! You also get access to the Module Store. I've put so much love into this editor ❤️
migration.notice_dismiss: Got it, don't show again on this view

home.add_type_first: You need to add a card type first
home.changelog_intro: If you want to know what's new in this version, you can check the changelog {link}.
home.resources_body: If you have an issue or a question you can find more details in the GitHub documentation. You can also find useful resources and help in these links.
home.support_body1: Hi I'm Clooos the Bubble Card developer. I dedicate most of my spare time to making this project the best it can be. So if you appreciate my work, any donation would be a great way to show your support.
home.support_body2: Also, check out my Patreon for exclusive custom styles, templates, and modules. Subscribing is probably the best way to support me and keep this project going.
home.thanks: Thank you for being part of this awesome community! Cheers from Belgium! 🍻

styles.title: Custom styles & JS templates
styles.body1: For advanced users, you can edit the CSS style of this card in the above code editor. More information and examples {examples_link}. You don't need to add {code} (only used in YAML mode). You can also add {templates_link} (Jinja is not supported).
styles.body2: Check out my {patreon_link} for more custom styles, templates, and modules. This is also the best way to show your support to my project.
styles.error_delayed: JS template errors can sometimes be delayed in the Module Editor.

popup.performance_body: Slightly delays content rendering and background blur, also disables backdrop blur if set.
popup.duplicate_hash_body: This hash is already used by another pop-up on this view. Please choose a different one.
popup.bottom_offset_body: Useful when your dashboard includes a footer card and the pop-up needs extra space at the bottom.
popup.include_example_disabled: (disabled because pop-up is already in a vertical stack)
popup.intro1: Pop-ups are a great way to declutter your dashboard and quickly display more information when you need it.
popup.intro2: If it's your first time creating a pop-up, you can use the example configuration to get started.
popup.hidden_header_body: You can completely hide the pop-up header, including the close and previous buttons. To close it when hidden, either make a long swipe within the pop-up or click outside of it.
popup.close_outside: Close the pop-up by clicking outside of it (a refresh is needed)
popup.close_on_click: Close the pop-up after any click or tap
popup.background_update_body: Background updates are only recommended if you encounter issues with certain cards within your pop-up.
popup.close_when_unmet: Close pop-up when conditions are not met
popup.conditions_body1: The pop-up will be opened when ALL conditions are fulfilled. For example you can open a "Security" pop-up with a camera when a person is in front of your house.
popup.conditions_body2: You can also create a toggle helper ({code}) and trigger its opening/closing in an automation.
popup.actions_body: This allows you to trigger an action on pop-up open/close.
popup.top_offset_mobile: Top offset on mobile (e.g. -56px if your header is hidden)
popup.top_offset_desktop: Top offset on desktop (e.g. 50vh for a half-sized pop-up)
popup.width_desktop: Width on desktop (100% by default on mobile)
popup.bg_color: Background colour (any var, hex, rgb or rgba value)
popup.hide_backdrop: Hide pop-up backdrop (a refresh is needed)
popup.hide_backdrop_body: This will hide the pop-up backdrop, which is a dark overlay that appears behind the pop-up.
popup.how_to_body: Each pop-up is {hidden_bold} and {open_bold} (e.g., '#pop-up-name'), with {any_card_link} that supports the {navigate_code} {action_link}.
popup.how_to_open_bold: can be opened by targeting its hash
popup.onboarding_body: {bold} and can be opened via a {navigate} action. Here's how to set it up:
popup.onboarding_body_bold: Once created, this pop-up will be hidden by default
popup.step2_body: Set any card's tap action to {navigate} and select that pop-up hash as the path. Tapping it will open this pop-up.

button.entity_slider: Entity (See text below for supported entities)
button.info_intro: This card is very versatile. It can be used as a {switch}, a {slider}, a {state} or a {name} button. Select the type of button you want to get more information about it.
button.switch_body: This is the default button type. By default, it toggles an entity and its background colour changes based on the entity's state or the colour of a light. You can change its action in the {section} section.
button.slider_body: This button type lets you control entities with adjustable ranges. It's ideal for dimming lights, and its fill colour will adapt to the light's colour. You can also use it to display values, such as a battery level.
button.slider_any: You can also use any entity with a {numeric} by disabling the entity filter in {settings}, then define the {min} and {max} values. This option is read only.
button.state_body: Perfect for displaying information from a sensor or any entity. When you press it, it will show the "More info" panel of the entity. Its background colour does not change.
button.name_body: The only button type that doesn't need an entity. It allows you to display a short text, a name or a title. You can also add actions to it. Its background colour does not change.

climate.info_body: This card allows you to control your climate entities. You can also add a sub-button that display a dropdown menu for your climate modes (check if you have "Select menu" available when you create a new sub-button).

cover.info_body: This card allows you to control your covers.

media_player.behavior_body: Outside of the editor, buttons other than the power button only appear if the media player is turned on.
media_player.info_body: This card allows you to control a media player entity.

select.info_body: This card allows you to have a select menu for your entities with selectable options:

separator.info_body: This card is a simple separator for dividing your pop-up/dashboard into categories or sections. e.g. Lights, Devices, Covers, Settings, Automations...

empty_column.info_body: Just an empty card to fill any empty column.

sub_buttons_card.footer_centered: Footer will be centred on the page
sub_buttons_card.footer_distance_helper: Distance from the bottom of the page (default: 16px)
sub_buttons_card.info_body: This card can only contain sub-buttons, perfect for displaying information, creating menus, and even a fixed footer menu at the bottom of the page.

hbs.width_desktop: Width on desktop (100% by default on mobile)
hbs.rise_animation: Rise animation (Displays an animation once the page has loaded)
hbs.presence_sensor: Presence / Occupancy sensor (For button auto order)
hbs.info_body: This card is a good companion to the pop-up card, allowing you to open pop-ups or any page of your dashboard. In addition, you can add your motion sensors so that the order of the buttons adapts according to the room you just entered. This card is scrollable, remains visible and acts as a footer.
hbs.info_auto_order: In fact you can also get the auto order with any entity type, for example you can add light groups to these fields and the order will change based on the last changed states.

calendar.info_body: This card allows you to display a calendar and is scrollable, so you can view additional events.

modules.title: Modules
modules.bct_required_body1: Since v3.1.0, to install, edit or delete modules, and to use the Module Store, please install {link} (everything is explained there).
modules.bct_required_body2: Your existing modules will be automatically migrated once Bubble Card Tools is installed.
modules.bct_required_body3: {no_modules} To create and manage modules and to use the Module Store, please install {link} (everything is explained there).
modules.import_yaml_hint: Paste the complete YAML code of the module:
modules.use_carefully_body: Some modules may work despite being marked as unsupported, while others can fail entirely.
modules.all_cards_help_body: Modules with custom editors cannot be applied globally. This feature is reserved for modules that only apply styles.
modules.no_modules_match: No modules match your search criteria. Try modifying your search or sort order.
modules.info_body1: Modules are really powerful and the best way to apply {styles_link} and/or {templates_link} to your cards, without having to copy/paste the same code over and over again.
modules.info_body2: This makes it easy to change things like the styles of all your cards, and for advanced users, to modify or add features with a real editor.
modules.info_body3: {coding}, you can also find and install modules made by the community in the {store}.
modules.default_module_description: Empty and enabled by default. Add your custom styles and/or JS templates here to apply them to all cards by pressing the {icon} button above.

store.bct_required_body1: To use the Module Store and to install/edit modules, install {tools}.
store.bct_required_body2: Existing modules will still be read from legacy sources for compatibility.
store.bct_required_body3: {no_modules} To install or edit modules and use the Module Store, install {tools}.
store.loading_error_body: Could not load modules from GitHub: {error}
store.title: Module Store
store.only_compatible: Show only modules compatible with the {card_type} card
store.ranking_body1: Due to a limitation in GitHub's API, only top-level reactions like ❤️ 👍 🚀 on the main discussion post are counted for popularity, along with other factors like recent activity, number of comments, updates...
store.ranking_body2: Click the "More info" button and show some love there if you find a module useful!
store.rate_limit_body: GitHub API rate limit was reached. The module list is loaded from cache.
store.no_modules_match: No modules match your search criteria. Try modifying your search or filters.
store.status_rate_limited: Rate limit reached - Using cached data
store.translate_offer_body: Modules are published in English. Bubble Card can translate their descriptions and options into your language, but this sends that text to an external translation service. It stays off until you turn it on.

module_editor.readonly_body: This Module is installed from a YAML file. You need to modify the {file} file directly, or remove it from your YAML file then import it here.
module_editor.module_id_helper: Must be unique and cannot be changed after the Module is created.
module_editor.creator: Creator
module_editor.description_helper: This description appears in your module and in the Module Store (if you share it), so make sure it's clear and concise. {bold}, but note that it will only be rendered in your module, the Module Store will not display it.
module_editor.description_helper_bold: You can use HTML and inline CSS
module_editor.code_helper: More information and examples about the CSS and JS template possibilities can be found in the {link}. Tip: You can enlarge the editor by clicking on the panel title (Bubble Card configuration).
module_editor.editor_schema_helper: This allows you to add a visual editor to your module. Learn about all available editor schema options in the {link}.
module_editor.suggestions_rules_helper: This allows your Module to be offered in the entity card picker of Home Assistant, as a list of rules. Learn about all available options in the {link}.
module_editor.suggestions_code_helper: When a configuration has to be computed instead of being known in advance, write a function body called with {args}. It must be synchronous, and return one entry, a list of entries, or nothing. See the {link}.
module_editor.suggestions_rules_invalid: The suggestion rules must be a list.
module_editor.suggestions_preview_empty: This Module offers no suggestion for this entity.
module_editor.suggestions_preview_toggle: Show the suggestions instead of the card
module_editor.fix_yaml_error: Fix the error(s) in the Editor schema (YAML) above to enable saving.
module_editor.fix_template_error: Fix the error(s) in the CSS/JS template above to enable saving.
module_editor.fix_suggestions_error: Fix the error(s) in the Entity suggestions above to enable saving.
module_editor.github_copied: GitHub Discussion format copied to clipboard!
module_editor.export_preview_hint: Click on a button above to generate the preview
module_editor.sharing_title: Sharing your Module to the Store
module_editor.sharing_body1: To share your Module to the Module Store, click on {copy} and paste the content in a new discussion in the {category} category. {edit_description} (if needed), {example} (for YAML users), and remember to {screenshot} for the Module Store.
module_editor.sharing_body2: {available} (after a Store refresh), so double-check that everything is correctly written and the Module is working as expected. You can of course edit/update the Module after it is shared.
module_editor.sharing_available: Your Module becomes available right after that
module_editor.supported_helper: Select the card types that this module supports.
module_editor.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete module "{id}"?
module_editor.install_bct_warning: Install Bubble Card Tools to save modules persistently
module_editor.copy_error: Could not copy to clipboard. Please copy manually from the preview below.

errors.entity_required: You need to define an entity
